title: PointMapManifest (DRAFT v0.1.0 - field names not locked)
description: Draft schema for the PortGatewayService point-table config named in 跨软件接口与参数标准-v1.1.md section 18.4. This is a proposal pending real PLC model/firmware/TIA confirmation - see PortGatewayService点表配置格式草案-v0.1.md for rationale and open questions. Do not treat any field name here as standard-locked.

manifestVersion.description: Version of this manifest FILE FORMAT itself (this schema), semantic-version style. Distinct from pointMapVersion below.

pointMapVersion.description: Version of THIS point table's content, in the same style already used by V1.1 elsewhere (StationProfile.pointMapVersion, WorkOrderSnapshot.pointMapVersion, gateway.session.prepare payload) e.g. 'QC-IO-1.0.0'.

readableRegions.description: Contiguous byte ranges read in one batch (V1.1 3.3: 必须批量读写连续数据区，禁止按每个点位建立独立请求). Backs EquipmentInputFrame-style fields flowing PLC -> Gateway -> scene.

writableWhitelistRegions.description: Contiguous byte ranges Gateway is allowed to write (V1.1 10.3: Gateway只允许向点表白名单写入反馈字段. 评分和训练档案字段不得写入PLC). Scoring/training-record fields must never appear here.

safeDefaults.description: semanticField -> safe value written on startup and on entering SafeHold. Keys must be a subset of semanticFields declared in readableRegions/writableWhitelistRegions.

configSha256.description: V1.1 section 16/17: SHA-256 of this file's canonical bytes, sha256: prefix + lowercase hex.

signatureAlgorithm.description: V1.1 section 17: SceneManifest/PointMapManifest/离线任务包/评分规则使用ECDSA-P256-SHA256签名.

semanticField.description: Should match an existing field name from V1.1 section 10.2 EquipmentInputFrame / 10.3 SimulatorFeedbackFrame where one exists, so the point table stays traceable to the wire protocol it ultimately feeds.

offsetBytes.description: Byte offset relative to the enclosing region's startByte, not an absolute DB offset.

bitIndex.description: Required when dataType is Bool; bit position (0-7) within the byte at offsetBytes.

dataType.description: S7-style raw types; not tied to a specific driver library's enum since none is chosen yet (see PortGatewayService/README.md).

scale.description: Multiplier applied to the raw value before it becomes the semantic field's value. Omit for Bool points.

deadband.description: V1.1 section 18.4 'zh:死区'. Minimum change (in the scaled unit) before a new value is considered a real change. Omit for Bool points.

unit.description: Human-readable unit note (V1.1 section 5.4 unit conventions), e.g. 'm', 'm/s', 'normalized -1..1'. Not itself part of the field name suffix convention; that lives in semanticField.
